title: Uniform pushforward under reindexing
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\Omega'$ be finite nonempty sets, let $g$ map $\Omega$ to the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$. If the distribution on the cube induced by a uniform element of $\Omega$ is $\varepsilon$-biased, then the distribution induced by $g\circ e$ from a uniform element of $\Omega'$ is also $\varepsilon$-biased, for every bijection $e:\Omega'\to\Omega$.
